comments.body:
Ship Skills:
Emergency Acceleration: Large Gaff Sail + Antifouling Paint
Galley: Galley + Warehouse
High Lookout: High Quality Rigging + Mast Top
Paymaster Cabin: Galley + Money Chest
Improved Hold: Special Ship Hold
Military Camouflage: Modified Heavy Gun Port + Control Tower
Wind-Resistant Mast: Large Mast + Set of Repair Tools
Everyday Item Storage: Warehouse + Money Chest
General Luxury Goods Storage: Aide's Cabin + Money Chest

R20 +25% Refitted (no mods or grade bonus) Cargo: 1247.

Excellent set of skills. The highlight of this ship is Military Camouflage on a trade ship.
